messages:
morgan: Night-owl FYI — I'm up for the 02:00 release tonight. Quick checklist: who will take the handoff at 03:30 if I need to escalate? Also need a smoke-owner and someone to watch rollback readiness.

alex: I can be on-call for the 03:30 handoff. I'll be available until 05:00. ping me at @alex if you need me to jump in.

jamie: I can own smoke runs. I'll do the smoke checklist at +5m after deploy and post results.

morgan: perfect — @alex handoff, @jamie smoke. Quick runbook I'm going to follow: https://runbook.redwood.internal/release/night-owl (see "smoke & rollback" section).

sam: What's the rollback plan? last time we had to revert the model variant — anything different tonight?

morgan: no big changes to rollback. Plan: 1) Pause traffic via router 2) Rollback to v3.2-tagged image 3) Clear KV-cache if needed. Commands below:

morgan: ```bash
# pause routing
curl -X POST "https://router.redwood.internal/pause" -d '{"route":"inference-prod"}'
# rollback image
kubectl --context prod set image deploy/inference inference=redwood/inference:v3.2 --record
# wait for rollout
kubectl --context prod rollout status deploy/inference --timeout=4m
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window: 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC -> 02:10 UTC. Canary group: 5% traffic for 10m. Autobalance: enabled.

ops-bot: Pre-deploy checks passed: node-health OK, gpu-util < 70%, infra-queue depth nominal.

jamie: Smoke checklist I'll run (short): 1) health endpoints 2) simple gen (short prompt) 3) embeddings sanity 4) latency p95 check. Will paste results.

tanya: Heads-up: if latency p95 > 600ms we should abort and fallback to v3.1 — I can flip the routing. Also check KV cache size before canary.

alex: A couple of quick asks: please confirm the model artifact checksum in the release note (sha256). If it mismatches, don't promote to full rollout.

morgan: noted. I'll verify artifact sha256 and post it here 15m before deploy.

jamie: @morgan ping me when smoke starts, I'll run the quick prompt battery and post pass/fail lines.

sam: small code review ping — PR #4211 has a tweak to the readiness probe. If that gets merged before the deploy, let me know; otherwise I'll hold it for next window.

morgan: do not merge PR #4211 until after the deploy unless we need an emergency hotfix. We'll keep probe change separate.

alex: :thumbsup: all set from my side. planning to be on call.

morgan: thanks team. I'll post the artifact sha and brief pre-deploy at T-15. If anything changes, update this thread. Good night / morning depending on timezone. :coffee:
